validation.message: Audio demo UI lists sounds, wires buttons, and reflects AudioManager stats

solver.message:
Implemented:
- `res://scenes/audio_demo.tscn`: full-screen layout, 20px margins, centered two-column grid with 10px spacing, and the specified top-bar node order and font.
- `res://scripts/audio_demo.gd`: exported `sound_dir`, dynamic WAV/OGG buttons using Poppins, playback through `AudioManager.play()`, and live stream/queue counters.

Verified in Godot 4.4.1: inspected the rendered scene and confirmed all eight buttons enqueue correct paths, audio streams load, and counters update correctly.
